scripts.setup: if [ -n "${CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH:-}" ] && [ -f "$CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH/.env.local" ]; then ln -sf "$CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH/.env.local" .env.local; else echo "Missing CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH/.env.local; skipping link"; fi && if [ -f .env.local ]; then if [ -L app/.env.local ]; then rm -f app/.env.local; fi; ln -sf ../.env.local app/.env; else echo "No .env.local in workspace; skipping app/.env link"; fi && if [ -f "$HOME/.claude/settings.json" ] && command -v /usr/bin/jq >/dev/null; then for k in TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN; do v=$(/usr/bin/jq -r ".env.$k // empty" "$HOME/.claude/settings.json"); if [ -n "$v" ]; then launchctl setenv "$k" "$v" && echo "launchctl: set $k"; fi; done; fi && cd app && bun install
